# bugs #2970: sdas opens the .rel file in text mode again since r16921, which removes the fix of r12963

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/2970/
- Category: [Analyzed, not fixed](../../unresolved.md)
- Evidence: judged by reading, against r17176
- Recommended action: Reopen. Open the files that sdas writes in binary mode again, or accept CRLF after the ;!FILE line in asxxxx_is_rel.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The fix for this ticket is not in effect in r17176.
[r12963](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/12963/) changed `afile` in `sdas/asxxsrc/asmain.c` to
open the files that the assembler writes with the mode `"wb"`.
[r16921](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/16921/) changed the mode for the write code 1 to
`"w"`. `main` in the same file passes the code 1 for the `.lst`, `.rel`, and `.sym` files. No code
in `sdas` selects binary mode in another way. By the code, sdas on a Windows host writes these
files with CRLF line endings again.

This was read in the source. No Windows host was available, and sdas was not run on Windows.

Two parts were run on a Linux host with r17176 for mcs51. The build in the ticket, with `--debug`,
`sdar`, and two libraries, links without a message. After the line endings in the `.rel` files of
the four library members were changed to CRLF, `sdar` printed the message of the ticket for each
file, and the linker reported `_bar`, `_bat`, and `_mat` as undefined. These are the symptoms in
the ticket. The same build without `--debug` links without a message with CRLF files.

## Known

`asxxxx_is_rel` in `support/sdbinutils/bfd/asxxxx.c` rejects the files. With `--debug` the `.rel`
file starts with a `;!FILE` line. `asxxxx_skip_line` stops at the `\r` of that line, and
`asxxxx_get_eol` accepts the `\r` and does not read the `\n` after it. `asxxxx_is_rel` then reads
the `\n` as the first character of the format line and reports it, which is the `\012` in the
message. A file without the `;!FILE` line does not reach this code, so the defect needs `--debug`.

r16921 has the log message "More small changes from upstream asxxxx". The lines that it removed
from `afile` include the comment that r12963 added.

## Open

By the code, either of two changes removes the defect. The first is the mode `"wb"` for the write
code 1 in `afile`, as in r12963. The second is a change to `asxxxx_is_rel` that reads a `\n` after
the `\r` of the `;!FILE` line. A build for a Windows host is needed to confirm either one.

The ticket has the status pending-fixed.
